name: IntelliASHA Agent Network
description: Multi-agent AI system for ASHA worker visit verification, disease surveillance, and health incentive reconciliation in India's public health infrastructure.

provider.organization: IntelliASHA × AI House × Google for Developers

agents.name: field-agent
agents.description: Processes ASHA worker voice transcriptions (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali, Kannada, English) into structured health visit data using Gemini 2.5 Flash. Supports offline-first data capture with automatic sync.

skills.name: process-voice-note
skills.description: Extract structured health visit data from voice transcription

agents.name: verification-agent
agents.description: Autonomous visit verification agent. Performs geo-accuracy checks, visit duration validation, household frequency analysis, data completeness verification, and Gemini-powered medical plausibility assessment.

skills.name: verify-visit
skills.description: Run multi-dimensional verification on a submitted field visit

agents.name: alert-agent
agents.description: Receives anomaly reports from Verification Agent via A2A task queue. Classifies alert severity using Gemini, creates supervisor alerts, sends FCM push notifications, and runs scheduled zero-visit zone detection.

skills.name: create-alert
skills.description: Create and classify a supervisor alert from an anomaly detection

skills.name: zero-visit-scan
skills.description: Detect workers with no visits in 48 hours

agents.name: analytics-agent
agents.description: Generates AI-powered district health intelligence by combining real Firestore visit data with Gemini 2.5 Flash analysis and Google Search grounding. Produces weekly briefs, PHC breakdowns, and outbreak risk scoring.

skills.name: generate-dashboard
skills.description: Generate full district health dashboard with AI brief and metrics

agents.name: incentive-agent
agents.description: Calculates NHM-compliant Task-Based Incentive disbursements. Performs ghost reporting detection using visit pattern analysis, deducts flagged visits, and generates audit-ready disbursement reports with Gemini-powered risk assessment.

skills.name: calculate-incentive
skills.description: Calculate TBI disbursement for an ASHA worker with ghost reporting detection

flows.description: Field Agent saves visit → triggers Verification Agent automatically
Verification Agent creates A2A task → Alert Agent processes
Analytics Agent can delegate TBI calculations to Incentive Agent
